He aha ka GSM?
ʻO kaʻenehana GSMʻo ia kaʻenehana i hiki iāʻoe (80) o nā mea hoʻohana pūnaewele no ka hanaʻana i nā leo i kā lākou mau kelepona. I keʻano,ʻo ia ke alaula maʻamau a me ka laulā maʻamau i hoʻohanaʻia no kaʻike pūnaewele.
Ua hoʻi houʻo GSM i ka makahiki 1982 a ua kapaʻiaʻo ia ma hope o ka hui i kohoʻia,ʻo Groupe Spécial Mobile, kahi o ka GSM acronym. Ua hoʻokuʻuʻia ka kawa kūlana ma Finland i ka makahiki 1991. Ua kapaʻiaʻo ia he Global Systems for Mobile communications.
Kūkuluʻiaʻo GSM he 2G (lua o ka hanauna) kawa. Hana ia me nā pūnaewele,ʻo ia ke kumu i kapaʻia ai kahi pūnaewele GSM he kikowaena pūnaewele, a me nā lekaleʻa e hoʻohana ana i ka GSM i kapaʻia he mau cell phones. He aha ke kikowaena? Hoʻokomoʻia ka pūnaewele GSM i loko o nā pūnaewele,ʻo kēlā me kēia mea e uhi ai i kahi'āpana. Loaʻaʻia nā lekini (kelepona) a kamaʻilio pūʻia me kēia mau pūnaewele.
